newsitem.title: USA: Fundamentals must be Mexico focus, not peso - Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Fundamentals must be Mexico focus, not peso - Rubin.

text.p: Mexico should focus on getting its economic fundamentals right and its currency will take care of itself, U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin told reporters on Wednesday.
"Over time, currencies tend to follow fundamentals and the key in Mexico is to focus on the fundamentals," he said after Mexico announced plans to repay its U.S. loans early.

Rubin said that Mexico has made progress in putting its economy in shape, but still faces challanges. Deputy Treasury Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers added that Mexico's banking system still faced strains despite the progress made.
The United States made nearly $580 million in profits on the emergency bail-out package for Mexico, Rubin said.
A statement issued by the White House said that "Mexican interest payments have resulted in a net gain of nearly $580 million for the American taxpayer."
